added.text: If the side signalling lamp is a category 6 direction indicator, the lamp shall show an 'R' or 'L' marking identifying the vehicle side.
added.test_case: Inspect lamp; pass if 'R' or 'L' matching its mounting side is shown.

added.text: If the side signalling lamp is a category 5 or 6 direction indicator, its luminous intensity distribution shall additionally be checked 0.2 seconds after switch-on at reference coordinate H5, V0, as specified in R148 Annex 8 Table A8-1.
added.test_case: Measure intensity at H5, V0 0.2 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; pass if all test points comply.

reason: Restore only saved R148 duties for the explicitly drawn side signalling lamp; leave uncertain active grille-shutter requirement out.
